column4: Lefff conjugates it second group (automaintenis); it derives from tenir (automaintiens, automaintiendrai) like all -tenir verbs. Bescherelle: tenir, type 22.
Lefff writes taît; taire takes no circumflex in the 3sg present (only plaît does). Grevisse §778.
Lefff conjugates it on a meur- stem (énameure); s'énamourer is a regular -er verb: énamoure. TLFi s.v. énamourer.
Same Lefff meur-stem error as énamourer.
filète (Larousse) and filette (Lefff, Robert) are both attested; kaikki has only the grave form, Lefff only the doubled one.
échéant (canonical, cf. le cas échéant) and échoyant (Lefff) are both standard.
rassi and rassis are both attested past participles (pain rassis by analogy with the adjective).
Lefff writes fouts; the imperative is fous (pres2s without change), cf. fous le camp.
Same as foutre: contrefous, not contrefouts.
Lefff lists repusse for the 3sg; the imperfect subjunctive 3sg is repût (circumflex series of repus).
kaikki lists être; débrayer takes avoir (il a débrayé). The être row comes from the pronominal table.
Reflexive-only in practice (se peausser); the bare lemma takes avoir. kaikki's être reflects the pronominal table.
